input.summary:
parts/room-16.mjs furnishes bedroom 2: red bed on the west wall (bed()), chest dresser and flower pot on the north wall, desk fence and top slab with a stair chair on the east wall, red rug, barrel nightstand and standing lanterns, hanging ceiling lantern. Passes my unlocked test (light min 8, 0 dark, FIT OK).
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt, but all 21 of this room's writes are REFUSED: shell.mjs box() fills the interior with explicit air, which runParts counts as owned. Not worked around; the blocker is upstream.
Test harness at /tmp/room16-check/check.mjs builds shell + this room with no lock; room picture /tmp/room16-check/room.png.
left: BLOCKER (not in my module): parts/shell.mjs box() line 27 fills the room interior with "air", and runParts records every shell write as owned, so every room part's writes are refused in the real build (bedroom 2: 21 of 21 refused). Fix in the shell (leave interior cells unwritten; the grid is already air) or in runParts (treat air as unowned). I did not edit shell.mjs or build.mjs and did not bypass the lock.

Walk verdict not verified in the real build: in the test build the corridor and entrance parts are stubs, so the room reads UNREACHABLE (0 of 59 cells). Re-run `mcd room ... --only "bedroom 2"` on the full build once corridors (room-4/room-18) and the stair are in.
Door position conflict: the brief and plan say the door is at x31 on z50, but plan.md's grid shows the doorway at x29..30. The layout keeps x29..30 and the x28 lane clear. Reconcile in plan.md.

No fireplace: the chimney stack at x33..34 z46..47 is solid. A bedroom hearth needs the roofs part to leave a firebox in the stack face (north face z45 or west face x32) before hearth() can be called. Not built.
Checklist: not ticked. The elements item '8 bedrooms' is aggregate and stays open until all eight rooms are in the real build.

waste.what: Checked the room in a separate test build, because the real make.sh run refused every write and the room check could not run on the real output. I wrote a throwaway script that builds shell + this room onto a plain Grid with no runParts lock.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes and one extra script. The real refusal only showed up in the make.sh log, so I found the cause by reading shell.mjs and build.mjs.
waste.tool: A `mcd room --unlocked` (or a preview flag on make.sh) that runs the room check without the earlier-part lock, plus a make.sh summary line saying the room's writes were refused by which earlier part.

waste.what: Worked out the 9x7 floor grid, the bed facing, the stair facing for the chair and the barrel-and-lantern nightstand by hand, then wrote the four layers as text.
waste.cost: about 10 minutes of reasoning, one layer rewrite after the light check.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` already gives the grid. A furnishing helper that takes a legend of roles (bed, dresser, desk, chair, lamp) and places them with the right states would have saved the state lookups.

waste.what: Checked the doorway position by counting characters in the plan grid, because the brief said x31 and the grid shows x29..30.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` should print the doorway coordinates as a list next to the grid, so the brief and the built door can be compared directly.

companions.task: Cut the firebox for the bedroom hearth into the chimney stack face (north z45 or west x32) and leave it air before the roofs part closes the stack.
Remove the explicit air fill over the room interiors in shell.mjs box() so that runParts does not lock every room's interior against its furnisher.
Check the bedroom light map once the real build lands, since the shell and corridor lights change the levels.

structured_output.summary:
parts/room-16.mjs furnishes bedroom 2: red bed on the west wall (bed()), chest dresser and flower pot on the north wall, desk fence and top slab with a stair chair on the east wall, red rug, barrel nightstand and standing lanterns, hanging ceiling lantern. Passes my unlocked test (light min 8, 0 dark, FIT OK).
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt, but all 21 of this room's writes are REFUSED: shell.mjs box() fills the interior with explicit air, which runParts counts as owned. Not worked around; the blocker is upstream.
Test harness at /tmp/room16-check/check.mjs builds shell + this room with no lock; room picture /tmp/room16-check/room.png.
left: BLOCKER (not in my module): parts/shell.mjs box() line 27 fills the room interior with "air", and runParts records every shell write as owned, so every room part's writes are refused in the real build (bedroom 2: 21 of 21 refused). Fix in the shell (leave interior cells unwritten; the grid is already air) or in runParts (treat air as unowned). I did not edit shell.mjs or build.mjs and did not bypass the lock.

Walk verdict not verified in the real build: in the test build the corridor and entrance parts are stubs, so the room reads UNREACHABLE (0 of 59 cells). Re-run `mcd room ... --only "bedroom 2"` on the full build once corridors (room-4/room-18) and the stair are in.
Door position conflict: the brief and plan say the door is at x31 on z50, but plan.md's grid shows the doorway at x29..30. The layout keeps x29..30 and the x28 lane clear. Reconcile in plan.md.

No fireplace: the chimney stack at x33..34 z46..47 is solid. A bedroom hearth needs the roofs part to leave a firebox in the stack face (north face z45 or west face x32) before hearth() can be called. Not built.
Checklist: not ticked. The elements item '8 bedrooms' is aggregate and stays open until all eight rooms are in the real build.

waste.what: Checked the room in a separate test build, because the real make.sh run refused every write and the room check could not run on the real output. I wrote a throwaway script that builds shell + this room onto a plain Grid with no runParts lock.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes and one extra script. The real refusal only showed up in the make.sh log, so I found the cause by reading shell.mjs and build.mjs.
waste.tool: A `mcd room --unlocked` (or a preview flag on make.sh) that runs the room check without the earlier-part lock, plus a make.sh summary line saying the room's writes were refused by which earlier part.

waste.what: Worked out the 9x7 floor grid, the bed facing, the stair facing for the chair and the barrel-and-lantern nightstand by hand, then wrote the four layers as text.
waste.cost: about 10 minutes of reasoning, one layer rewrite after the light check.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` already gives the grid. A furnishing helper that takes a legend of roles (bed, dresser, desk, chair, lamp) and places them with the right states would have saved the state lookups.

waste.what: Checked the doorway position by counting characters in the plan grid, because the brief said x31 and the grid shows x29..30.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` should print the doorway coordinates as a list next to the grid, so the brief and the built door can be compared directly.

companions.task: Cut the firebox for the bedroom hearth into the chimney stack face (north z45 or west x32) and leave it air before the roofs part closes the stack.
Remove the explicit air fill over the room interiors in shell.mjs box() so that runParts does not lock every room's interior against its furnisher.
Check the bedroom light map once the real build lands, since the shell and corridor lights change the levels.
